controls.title: Ensure updates, patches, and additional security software are installed
controls.assessment_contract: Determine available upgrades from authenticated configured repositories and fresh package metadata; record held packages, pending updates and reboot indication. A stale cache cannot prove a pass. Human review remains required for site applicability.
controls.remediation_contract: **U-1.2.2.1:** two explicit stages: approved metadata refresh, then exact package-version upgrade plan after simulation. Pin package/version/dependency list and its digest; changed solver output needs new approval. Show restart/reboot impacts. Verify package database, fresh upgrade simulation and required human review. Never run an unbounded automatic full distribution upgrade.
controls.direct_probe_reason: Upstream marks this Manual without rules. Read-only metadata/accounted update evidence plus bound human review is required; refresh is a separate approved action.
controls.authoritative_source_policy: PDF v2.0.0 compound predicate; reviewed effective-state probes override narrower SCAP examples. Conflict remains visible.

controls.direct_probe_reason: Both package states must be installed; package presence does not establish profile enforcement.

controls.direct_probe_reason: Resolve effective persistence and UFW IPT_SYSCTL overrides as well as runtime.

controls.title: Ensure prelink is not installed

Preview affected binaries, package transaction and disk needs. Snapshot required; record reversal/removal failures. Verify absence and basic executable health. No generic promise of an automatic reinstall rollback.
controls.direct_probe_reason: Package-query failure cannot establish absence; prelink reversal requires separate approved package/binary recovery.

controls.title: Ensure avahi daemon services are not in use
controls.assessment_contract: Avahi service/socket not running or enabled under the supported package-present configuration; package absence is an accepted path. Check all relevant units.
controls.remediation_contract: **U-2.1.2:** retain package where feasible and stop/disable/mask its service and socket, following the audited allowed state. Declare service dependency impacts. Verify units and listening sockets. Recovery restores prior mask/enabled/running states.
controls.direct_probe_reason: PDF allows package retention only when needed as a dependency and approved by local policy. Package removal and disabled service are alternative paths, not an unconditional AND.

controls.title: Ensure minimum password length is configured
controls.assessment_contract: Effective password-quality minimum length at least 14. Resolve PAM arguments and pwquality configuration precedence; a compliant drop-in overridden elsewhere is insufficient.

If PAM support is missing, include an explicit prerequisite installation/configuration plan. controls.direct_probe_reason: Resolve PAM arguments and pwquality precedence; a matching minlen file does not establish effective policy.

controls.title: Ensure password expiration is configured
controls.assessment_contract: Default maximum age and every applicable password-bearing account have a maximum in 1..365 days. Check consistency with minimum age. Do not export password hashes.
controls.remediation_contract: **U-5.4.1.1:** set default maximum to 365 and change only enumerated non-compliant eligible accounts to 365. Bind username, UID, prior aging values and account-set digest. Preview immediate expiration risks, especially the connection user; block unsafe execution until recovery/maintenance requirements are met. Verify defaults and each account.
controls.direct_probe_reason: Default and every applicable account must satisfy 1..365 and exceed minimum age. PDF remediation prose says 356 once; audit and example specify 365.
controls.authoritative_source_policy: PDF v2.0.0 compound predicate; reviewed effective-state probes override narrower SCAP examples. Conflict remains visible.
